name: julia-lsp
description: Julia code intelligence through LanguageServer.jl, installed in the shared environment @claude-lsp (julia --project=@claude-lsp -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.add("LanguageServer")'). Analyses the Julia project that contains the session's directory, else the default environment.

args: using LanguageServer; p = Base.current_project(ARGS[1]); runserver(stdin, stdout, p === nothing ? dirname(Base.load_path_expand("@v#.#")) : dirname(p))
